description:
JavaParser-based reader (.java → DomainMetadata) and idempotent writer
        (DomainMetadata → .java, preserving user comments, formatting, and
        non-Exeris annotations) for the canonical source model. Per ADR-037 this
        is a separate module so JavaParser stays off the dependency tree of
        exeris-sdk-source-model and its pure AST-record consumers (zero runtime
        coupling). Consumed by exeris-platform-lsp; NOT by the codegen/processor
        paths, which only need the AST records.
